brief.summary: Off-duty glamour built on great jeans. Light-wash straight or baggy denim is the constant, and the drama is all on top: an oversized crisp white shirt, a big black leather trench, a shaggy fur or a fur-trimmed leather maxi coat, a cropped brown leather jacket with shearling cuffs, a snake-print long coat. Proportions are big-on-top / straight-below. Finish with a black ballet flat (tabi or Mary Jane) or a slim pointed boot, a structured black shoulder bag and one statement silver earring or hoop. Evening goes long and lean: a black column midi or a bias satin slip skirt with a mannish coat over it and a strappy heel.
